content.short: Mnemonic provides NFT data and analytics APIs for reading, discovering, collecting, and analyzing data on Ethereum and Polygon.
content.description: Mnemonic offers a suite of APIs that lets developers read, discover, collect, and analyze NFT data on Ethereum and Polygon. It was co-founded in 2021 by Andrii Yasinetsky, Elena Ikonomovska, and Ben Metcalfe. With access to more than 30 million NFTs, 100,000 collections, and billions of transactions, Mnemonic enables querying nearly every NFT detail. Developers can use Mnemonic APIs to build tools for engagement and trading, backed by robust analytics and discovery capabilities across the NFT landscape.
content.meta: Mnemonic provides NFT data and analytics APIs for scalable NFT dapps on Ethereum and Polygon. Discover Mnemonic and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
